_comment: CREA — every client-specific name, path, key and preference lives here and NOWHERE else. Transplanting to Connell's Mac Mini means editing this file only.

identity._pronunciation_note: CREA is said KREE-ah. Text-to-speech reads the raw letters as 'cray', so any spoken line containing the name is rewritten to the phonetic spelling before synthesis. This also matters for the wake word: the speech model was transcribing the mispronounced name as 'Paycray'.

paths._comment: Deliberately NOT in iCloud: launchd/cron jobs do not run reliably from an iCloud-synced folder.

brain._escalate_note: Set to a paid model id to let hard single steps borrow a stronger brain. Null = free only.
brain._routing_note: Hermes points at OmniRoute (localhost:20128/v1), an OpenAI-compatible router over free cloud models. Zero local RAM, zero cost. Swap LM_BASE_URL in ~/.hermes/.env to go local (ollama) or paid (Anthropic).

voice._comment: Free tier is the default and must work standalone. Paid is a drop-in swap of these two strings — no code change.

tts._voice_note: 26 built-in voices, all free and on-device. Change 'voice' to any of them and restart the voice service. Cloning a specific person's voice is NOT available on the free tier — those weights are gated behind a HuggingFace licence. For a cloned voice use the paid ElevenLabs path.

stt.prompt: Hey CREA. CREA, pronounced kree-ah, is the assistant for Cfilms, a real estate photography business. Bookings, shoots, agents, invoices.
stt._prompt_note: Seeds the speech decoder so it expects the name CREA. Without this whisper transcribes it as 'Paycray' and the wake word never fires.

wake._note: Wake detection is fully on-device. No audio leaves the machine until the phrase fires.
wake._provider_note: vad-whisper works on day one with no training. Switch to 'openwakeword' only once a trained hey_crea.onnx exists at model_path — it is lower CPU but needs that file.

speaker_verification._note: OFF by default. When on, CREA only answers the enrolled voice — Siri's 'Recognise My Voice' rather than a HomePod that answers the room. Run 'crea enrol' first, then 'crea voice-check on'.
speaker_verification._threshold_note: Measured on this machine, twice. From clean audio: same speaker 0.83-0.84, different voice 0.55-0.59. Through the microphone the gap COMPRESSES — same 0.876, different 0.699 — because room acoustics are shared by both. 0.70 would have left 0.0004 of margin against the stranger, which is not a boundary. 0.75 keeps the owner comfortably above (+0.09 acoustic, +0.09 clean) and the stranger clearly below (-0.05). Enrol through the same microphone you'll actually use.
speaker_verification._measured: Verified end to end. Enrolment on SENTENCES (not the bare wake phrase): consistency 0.94. Live: enrolled speaker 0.94 ACCEPT, different voice 0.68 REJECT. Identity is checked on the COMMAND, not the wake phrase — a 2s phrase carries too little voiced audio (phrase-only enrolment self-scored just 0.87, genuine repeats landed 0.65).

bookings._source_note: 'n8n' = the automations pack takes bookings and writes job notes into this vault; CREA reads them and confirms/declines held bookings by voice. 'acuity' = CREA polls Acuity directly (acuity-sync on schedule).

integrations._status_note: 'ready' is computed live from real credentials, never stored. crea status tells the truth.

n8n._note: The crea's automations pack. Voice skills confirm-booking and message-client call its local webhooks.

whatsapp._mode_note: QR pairing like WhatsApp Web. Does NOT migrate the number to the Business Cloud API, so the consumer app and chat history survive. Unofficial client: small ban-risk, disclosed to the principal.

call_recording._legal: NSW Surveillance Devices Act 2007 s7 requires all-party consent. Disclosure below is played/spoken at call start to establish consent before any audio is retained. Jurisdiction is config, not code — do not ship this to another state without review.
call_recording.disclosure_text: Just so you know, I record calls so I get the booking details right.
call_recording._retain_note: false = transcribe then discard audio. Keeps the retained artifact to the booking facts only.

media_pipeline._gap_note: A break longer than this between shot timestamps starts a new shoot.
media_pipeline._format_note: never | ask | auto. Ships as 'never'. The card is the only irreplaceable copy until Drive confirms; auto-format is how you lose a client's shoot.
